title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.64
subtitle: AETHER: cleaner starts, a freer Grab, water settings can stay on.

highlights.title: Grab Cloth
highlights.description: No stretch limit: the cloth follows as far as you pull, and no vertices stay stuck on the body afterwards.

highlights.title: Clean starts
highlights.description: Cloth that starts inside the body is pulled out cleanly in more cases.

highlights.title: Water settings
highlights.description: GAIA Water Flow and TETHYS Wetness can stay on; the AETHER Engine simply ignores them.
